Bouncing line

Digits on the blue line must flow in a continuous ascending or descending order. However, hitting a 1 or a 9 breaks the flow and forces the opposite order to take over.

(e.g., an ascending sequence like 3-6-7-9-6-2-1-3 will immediately turn into a descending one after the 9, and then flip back to ascending after the 1).

Killer cage

Digits in a cage sum to the top-left number and cannot repeat.

HINTS
